name: Wit of the Scorched Tundra
body:
School evocation [cold, fire]; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Close (95 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target: One creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes 2d8 points of cold damage +1 point per caster level, and each creature adjacent to you takes 2d8 points of fire damage. Until the end of combat, each time you hit with a spell with the Jest keyword, until the end of your next turn each creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes fire damage equal to your caster level.
